name: Afrobeat Bass
description: Electric and upright basses for Afrobeat and highlife grooves: warm fingered bass, picked bass, a muted dub-style bass, a bright roundwound funk bass, a hollow-body bass, an upright and a short-scale bass. All patches are monophonic (a new note cuts the last) with short releases so lines stay tight.

patches.name: Finger Bass
patches.note: Squier Bass VI with flatwound strings, fingered, neck pickup (Pastabass 'fetuccine'). 4 velocity layers x 4 round robins. The warm all-round Afrobeat bass.

patches.name: Pick Bass
patches.note: Flatwound strings, picked, bridge pickup (Pastabass 'linguine'). 3 velocity layers x 4 round robins. More attack for driving lines.

patches.name: Muted Bass
patches.note: Flatwound, picked and muted, pickup combo (Pastabass 'tagliatelle'). Short, dry notes for dub-leaning and highlife-style grooves.

patches.name: Roundwound Funk Bass
patches.note: Roundwound strings (Pastabass 'spaghetti'). Brighter and more cutting, for afro-funk.

patches.name: Hollow-body Bass
patches.note: Washburn AB95 hollow-body bass, plucked (Black And Blue Basses 'darkblack pluck'). 4 velocity layers x 4 round robins. Round and woody.

patches.name: Upright Bass
patches.note: 1958 Otto Rubner double bass, pizzicato, played quietly (Sneakybass). One velocity layer, so loudness follows velocity but the tone does not change. Playable range E1 to F3: the pack's notes above that are drowned in low-frequency room noise, so they are left out.

patches.name: Short-scale Bass
patches.note: Short-scale bass, warm voicing (Black And Blue Basses 'babyblue warm'). One velocity layer.
